description: Defines the ComponentStore class implementing IComponentStore interface for managing media components in Android's Codec2 HAL, including methods for creating, listing, and managing components and interfaces.

classes.name: ComponentStore
classes.description: Implements IComponentStore interface for managing media components, providing methods for creation, listing, and debugging components within Android's Codec2 framework.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the construction status of the ComponentStore object.

methods.name: validateSupportedParams
methods.description: Validates if given parameters are supported.

methods.name: getParameterCache
methods.description: Returns the store's ParameterCache for validation.

methods.name: GetFilterWrapper
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to a FilterWrapper instance.

methods.name: createComponent
methods.description: Creates a media component with specified name and listener.

methods.name: createInterface
methods.description: Creates an interface with the given name.

methods.name: getStructDescriptors
methods.description: Retrieves structure descriptors for given indices.

methods.name: getPoolClientManager
methods.description: Returns the client manager for component pools.

methods.name: copyBuffer
methods.description: Copies data from source buffer to destination buffer.

methods.name: createComponent_1_1
methods.description: Creates a component with version 1.1 interface.

methods.name: createComponent_1_2
methods.description: Creates a component with version 1.2 interface.

methods.name: onInterfaceLoaded
methods.description: Handles bookkeeping when an interface is loaded.

methods.name: reportComponentBirth
methods.description: Records the creation time of a component.

methods.name: reportComponentDeath
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a component is destroyed.
